Lightweight Toddler Bike - The toddler bicycle weights only 6.28lbs(2.85kg), makes it easy for your child to ride and stride. A low step-through metal frame is designed for child rider easy for them to get on or off the bike. The frame is lightweight and durable, ensuring years of fun!
Your Children Will Like It - The toddler bike equipped with padded seat and soft grips, providing comfortable cycling for todders and easy control.
